title: Juicy Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A peppery and indulgent Tunisian dish featuring lamb, parsley, and namul, blanched and seasoned to perfection, this recipe is egg-free friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the ground cumin, ground coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the Dutch oven, and simmer for 2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the chopped parsley and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
